hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Clanker protocol hook that sets separate static LP fees for buying vs. selling the clanker token, applying them dynamically via updateDynamicLPFee on each swap. Collects protocol fees via delta manipulation in both beforeSwap and afterSwap, supports optional MEV protection modules (active for up to 2 minutes post-launch), and triggers LP locker fee claims on every swap.
